method: Native /completion with explicit model-specific integer token IDs. Cold = restarted process, first inference after readiness, model loading excluded. Hardware, GPU clocks and OS page caches are not reset. Cache misses are retained, not relabeled as hits.

timing_semantics.cache_n: Input KV hits; prompt_n + cache_n must equal submitted token count.
timing_semantics.tokens_evaluated: Full input count, NOT newly evaluated tokens (server-task.cpp).
timing_semantics.tokens_cached: Resident slot length after generation, NOT input KV hits.
timing_semantics.client_first_nonempty_content_ms: Monotonic wall time from dispatch to first nonempty native content; special/empty pieces and MTP batching may delay it.
timing_semantics.client_total_ms: Full HTTP/SSE request wall time, including prefill, decode, transfer, and evidence writes.

source_contract.apply_template: server-context.cpp post_apply_template -> server-common.cpp oaicompat_chat_params_parse(messages, chat_template_kwargs); returns {prompt: string}.
source_contract.tokenize: server-context.cpp post_tokenize honors add_special/parse_special; server-common.cpp integer input arrays are passed verbatim without implicit BOS/EOS.
source_contract.timings: server-common.cpp server_slot_stats::to_json, server-common.h n_gen_steps/n_gen_tps; server-task.cpp native final response.
source_contract.source_git_note: Inspected source directory is not a Git checkout; revision unavailable.
